title: Add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Marina Chen
body: This PR adds a first-class set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) quickstarts and agent/tool-calling examples to the redwood-examples repo and updates the docs site navigation and quickstart pages. Motivation: provide repeatable, copy-pasteable templates for teams evaluating RAG use cases (customer support, knowledge base answer, meeting notes) and to demonstrate safe tool-calling patterns in agents. The changes include: (1) YAML RAG templates for typical index types (chunked text, embeddings index, semantic search), (2) Python and TypeScript agent examples showing tool-calling patterns with retries and guarded tool outputs, (3) a walkthrough quickstart added to the docs site with step-by-step setup and a reference evaluation checklist. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG templates and README describing fields and recommended index settings - [x] Add Python agent example demonstrating search -> rerank -> tool call - [x] Add TypeScript example for browser-based demo (uses secure proxy sample) - [x] Update docs site TOC and quickstart pages - [x] Add unit tests for example code (lightweight smoke tests) - [x] Ensure linter and docs build pass Notes: kept examples lightweight and self-contained; samples use the redwood SDK and mock connectors where appropriate. See commits and changed files for details.

d4f9e18: add python agent tool-calling example (email/calendar mock connectors)

f3c9ab4: docs: add quickstart walkthrough and update TOC/nav

b1e9d22: fix: linter issues and doc link typos
review_comments: Evan Rodriguez: Nice set of examples — can we add a note about cost implications of high re-rank k and batch sizes?
Marina Chen: Added a paragraph in the quickstart under 'Performance & Cost' with recommended defaults and an example calculation.
Priya Nair: Docs build failed initially due to broken nav entry; can we keep quickstart under '/quickstarts/rag' and add redirect?
Marina Chen: Fixed nav.yml and added a redirect entry in docs config; re-ran build and it passed.
Liam O'Connor: Python example calls to external mock connectors should have clearer sandboxing instructions (env var names).
Marina Chen: Moved env var names to top of the example README and added guarded example code to avoid accidental outbound calls.
Evan Rodriguez: Tests look good; one nit — rename test file to follow test_*.py pattern
Marina Chen: Renamed test and updated CI matrix.
release_notes: Adds RAG quickstarts, RAG template specs, and agent/tool-calling examples (Python + TypeScript). Updates docs site navigation and quickstart pages. Includes lightweight smoke tests and examples README. Recommended: teams should review cost guidance before using high re-rank or large batch sizes.
notes: This change delivers reproducible quickstarts and lowers friction for evaluating RAG + agent flows; follow-up work (ENG-10234) will add additional connectors and a dataset used in the eval harness.
